sarah (Customer): Hi team — after updating to rwinf-sdk-go v0.9.4 our service starts receiving invalid JSON from the API when using "json_mode": "stream". Some messages end with partial fragment like "..." and then the stream closes. Not sure if it's client or server. Repro below.

maya (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, sarah. Can you post a minimal repro + raw bytes you see? Also which model/endpoint? We'll escalate if needed.

devin (Eng SDK): pinging to help repro. Quick q: is this ndjson/newline-delimited or JSON mode where full objects are streamed? If you can paste exact bytes that would help.

sarah (Customer): It's JSON mode (structured output route). Using model prod-psi, we get partial frames. Example from Go client raw read:
```
..."choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"{\"user\":\"al"}
```
stream closes. The Python client outputs similar but sometimes returns two top-level objects concatenated which breaks serde_json.

maya (Support): Thanks. Account: acme-llm-prod (ID: acct_9xxxx). We've paused retries server-side to avoid cost spikes. Can you confirm whether your clients are using the latest streaming parser patch? @devin

devin (Eng SDK): Reproduced locally with tiny tweak. Root cause looks like boundary handling when a JSON object is split across TCP frames and the parser attempts to decode on partial buffer. Go's `json.Decoder` expects complete token stream; our previous assumption that `ReadMessage` yields full object is wrong. Quick workaround: buffer until a closing curly count matches. Example pseudo-fix in Go client:
```
buf := bytes.Buffer{}
for chunk := range stream {
  buf.Write(chunk)
  if balanceBraces(buf.Bytes()) == 0 {
    var obj map[string]interface{}
    json.Unmarshal(buf.Bytes(), &obj) // safe now
    buf.Reset()
  }
}
```

leo (Eng Runtime): On the server side we try to flush records as soon as deltas are generated. We can change separators but that'd be a protocol change. Prefer fixing clients. We'll add a regression test for split-frame JSONs in the runtime tests.

sarah (Customer): Thanks — the Go workaround works for us. Any ETA for official SDK patch? Also can you re-run my job so we stop incurring retry charges? We saw a +40% token increase due to client retries.

maya (Support): Filed SEV-1082, assigning to Eng SDK (devin) and Eng Runtime (leo). We've issued a one-time credit for the spike and paused billing while we investigate. We'll update here with the patch PR link.

devin (Eng SDK): Will cut a patch this afternoon to v0.9.5 and add a streaming-json test harness (py/ts/go). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rwinf-sdk-go/pull/314 (draft). Please validate the patch before I cut the release.

sarah (Customer): Validated patch against our repro — fixed. :clap: Thanks all. Leaving tracing logs in case you need them: `trace-1806-acc9.zip`.

ops-bot: Incident SEV-1082 created by maya (Support). Status: triaged.
